findings.evidence: Line 415 has exterior bivectors on the left and `LieAlgebra.Orthogonal.so` on the right; Mathlib follows source-to-target order in `typeDEquivSo' : typeD … ≃ₗ⁅R⁆ so' …` and `soIndefiniteEquiv : so' … ≃ₗ⁅R⁆ so …`.
findings.fix: Rename it to `bivectorEquivSo` and update `soEquivBivector_apply_ιMulti` and `soEquivBivector_wedge_mulVec` to use the same prefix.
findings.issue: `soEquivBivector` reverses the source/target order: its type is `⋀² … ≃ₗ⁅R⁆ so …`, so the name misleadingly advertises a map from `so` to bivectors.

findings.evidence: Lines 454–456 conclude about `(bivectorEquivSo … (exteriorPower.ιMulti …)) *ᵥ x`; the adjacent line 438 and existing `bivectorExterior_apply_ιMulti` use the actual constructor name `ιMulti`.
findings.fix: After correcting the equivalence prefix, rename this to `bivectorEquivSo_apply_ιMulti_mulVec`.
findings.issue: `soEquivBivector_wedge_mulVec` says `wedge`, but its expression uses `exteriorPower.ιMulti`; this makes the theorem harder to discover alongside the adjacent `…_apply_ιMulti` lemma.

summary: The public equivalence and one associated theorem are named contrary to their actual source and expression.
